summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-style script (identifier mangling like `_0x488df8`, string-indirection tables) that downloads a Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/…zip`, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable (`chmodSync(..., 493)`), and invokes it via `execFileSync` against a bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (large `n7gIxM=[...]` string-array plus a `WV8StW` rotation function) whose behavior cannot be statically inspected. Executing an opaque payload under a freshly-fetched alternate runtime at `npm install` time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and evades Node-focused install-time inspection. The package name uses the `@servicetitan/*` scope and its `package.json` declares React/MobX micro-frontend dependencies, but a UI component library has no legitimate reason to fetch the Bun runtime or execute an obfuscated bundle at install time — consistent with impersonation of a legitimate internal ServiceTitan MFE package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
